title: Requires constant filter replacements
text: Requires constant filter replacements. Bought this because I wanted a purifier with a fleet I didn't have to change. This has the hepa that doesn't require changing but also 2 charcoal filters that DO require replacing every 3 months. Even so I gave it a chance. It was much louder than my other (no longer available) purifier, and I could only run it on whisper if I was trying to watch tv or talk on the phone. It also blew the air so much it created a stream of cold air through my dining and living area that was no enjoyable (even on whisper). To many negatives for me, so I sent it back. Didn't notice if it was helping the air quality but only ran it 2 days.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach TrueAir Air Purifier with Permanent HEPA Filter for Home or Office and for Allergies and Pets, Whisper Quiet, 3 Filtration Stages, 140 sq ft, White with Grey
features: 3 Filtration Stages: Permanent HEPA grade filter captures dander & particles plus 2 replaceable carbon zeolite filters to target plus a pre filter for pet hair and larger particles
High Performance Hepa Grade Filter: Captures 99 Percent of Pet Dander,, Pollen, and spores as Small as 3 Microns From the Air
2 Activated Carbon Zeolite Filters Help Reduce Unwanted Household From Pets, Smoke, and More
Quiet and Powerful: Use Whisper Clean for Extra Quiet Operation at Night, the Medium Setting or the Quick Clean Setting for More Powerful Air Cleaning
Easy to Clean: Permanent Hepa Grade Filter Can Be Vacuumed Clean; No Replacement Filters to Buy
description: The True Air Compact Air Purifier by Hamilton Beach offers 99.97% true HEPA cleaning performance in a compact design that fits anywhere in your home or office. Eliminate pesky pet odors and dander with the triple filtration technology that includes a permanent pre-filter to capture pet hair and large particles PLUS 2 zeolite filters to target pet, AND a permanent, HEPA-grade filter for capturing small particles as small as 3 microns. The permanent filters easily vacuum clean for minimal upkeep. Don’t let its compact size and ultra-quiet operation fool you – the True Air Compact Pet Air Purifier can provide powerful air cleaning to large rooms up to 140 square feet, making it ideal for bedrooms, nurseries, offices and dens. It’s not only compact and quiet, but it also works vertically or horizontally for maximum versatility.

The TrueAir Compact Air Purifier cleans and freshens the air in 3 ways: 1. The permanent pre-filter traps pet hair and large particles 2. Two replaceable carbon zeolite filters eliminate pet odors 3. A permanent 99% HEPA-grade filter captures smaller particles. This filter simply vacuums clean for minimal upkeep. Simply vacuum the HEPA-grade filter for minimal upkeep. The two carbon zeolite odor-eliminating filters should be replaced every 3 months. As a convenient reminder, a timestrip cartridge counts down the 3 months and indicates when it is time to replace.
